objective: Bring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.

description: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.
completion: Stoutly done, <name>. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.
You are a <race> of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.
